simple.meaning: an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west ; also (adverb with preposition) towards
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָבוֹא (H3996) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

definitions.short: an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west ; also (adverb with preposition) towards
definitions.usage: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, westward. Compare 4126 .
definitions.full: H3996. mabo מָבוֺא noun masculine Jer 38:14 entrance, a coming in, entering ; — ׳מ absolute 38:14 3 t. + Ezek 42:9 Kt (Qr מֵבִיא wrong, compare Co); construct מְבוֺא Deut 11:30 12 t.; suffix מְבוֺאוֺ Psa 104:19 2 t.; מְבֹאוֺ 50:1 ; מבואך 2Sam 3:25 Kt (Qr מוֺבָאֶ֑ךָ inexplicable compare Dr); plural construct מְבוֺאֵי Ezek 26:10 , מְבוֺאֹת 27:3 ; — 1 entrance , i.e. place or way of entrance, into a city Judg 1:24-25 , 1Chr 4:39 ; Prov 8:3 ( ׳מ מְּתָחִים ); into buildings 2Kin 11:16 ; 16:18 ; 1Chr 9:19 ( הַמָּבוֺא שֹׁמְרֵי ), 2Chr 23:13 , 15 ; Jer 38:14 ; Ezek 42:9 ; 46:19 ; see also יָם מְבוֺאֹת entrance of (the) sea, gate of the sea , of situation of Tyre 27:3 . 2 entering , act of entrance, by violence, in storm of city Ezek 26:10 ; coming in or together, making a crowd, עָ֑ם כִּמְבוֺא 33:31 simile of eagerness to hear Yahweh's word; in phrase וְאֶתמֿבואך אֶתמֿוֺצָאֲךָ 2Sam 3:25 thy going out and thy coming in, mode of entering temple , or the people who enter Ezek 44:5 ; particularly of sunset הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא Psa 104:19 ; = west Deut 11:30 ; Josh 1:4 ; 23:4 הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא הַגָּדוֺל הַיָּם = Mediterranean, Zech 8:7 הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא אֶרֶץ (|| מִזְרָח אֶרֶץ ), Mal 1:11 ; Psa 50:1 ; 113:3 sunset = west , opposed to sunrise = east; in phrase from east to west , i.e. over the whole earth, everywhere on earth.
